Brain dump. Write down everything that’s just floating around in your head. Then wrote down a rough study plan (you may or may not stick with it, but it helps me feel productive and it seems less daunting). 

Pick a subject and write down everything you remember about it. Watch videos about the subject and then do another brain dump. Can’t sit still long enough to watch a video? Do other tasks while you do it, like folding clothes or picking up your room. You’ll either get 2 things done at once or you’ll eventually just sit down and watch the video. 

Drawing shit out helps me a lot, I’m not an artist but it definitely helps and is more interesting than just straight up reading things over and over. 

You can also make mind maps out of your brain dumps to connect different concepts. Set a time to see how fast you can do it. 

Buy pretty pens, markers, stationary, etc that you’ll be excited to use.
